Game Overview

In Rainbow Bead, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in Rainbow Bead, where strategic thinking meets vibrant puzzle-solving. Slide and connect colorful beads, outsmarting foes in thrilling matches. Opt for exciting challenges of varying bead counts, and relish every brain-teasing moment. Whether solo or multiplayer, endless fun awaits as you refine your reflexes and strategy.
